programme: EP300 and CREBBP (the paralogous CBP/p300 acetyltransferase coactivators) set the level of enhancer/promoter acetylation for inducible transcription; JARID2 supplies the counterweight by recruiting PRC2 to deposit the opposing repressive mark; SMARCE1 co-regulates its own BAF/SWI-SNF partners (SMARCA4, SMARCB1) to control chromatin accessibility; CTCFL (BORIS), a CTCF paralog normally silenced outside testis, is aberrantly reactivated to rewrite the local insulator/3D-chromatin landscape. Together these five factors form a chromatin-state module that gates how strongly a given locus can be turned on.
role_in_a: In COVID-19, CBP/p300 acetylation is the coactivation step for NF-κB- and IRF-driven cytokine/interferon-stimulated gene transcription that underlies the inflammatory response (CREBBP sits at the 97th Open Targets percentile for COVID-19; EP300 at the 48th). JARID2 is separately flagged as a predicted target of SARS-CoV-2-encoded microRNAs acting on NF-κB/JAK-STAT/TGFB signaling (PMID 33398248), consistent with the virus tuning the acetylation/methylation balance of this module to shape the host inflammatory output.
role_in_b: In endometrioid cancer, EP300/CREBBP loss-of-function (as in the germline Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome case, PMID 25675181, where the patient developed endometrioid adenocarcinoma) removes a differentiation/tumour-suppressive brake on transcription. CTCFL/BORIS is a recurrent cancer-testis reactivation in ovarian/epithelial carcinoma that reshapes the CTCF cistrome and drives an invasive, androgen-receptor-linked transcriptional programme (PMID 31516605, 31406110, 31292201); SMARCE1's coordinate regulation of core BAF subunits echoes the SWI/SNF dysregulation characteristic of this tumour type.
shared_axis: Both diseases depend on the same acetylation-versus-methylation, chromatin-accessibility balance to control inducible transcription: COVID-19 uses it acutely to amplify inflammatory/interferon gene output, while endometrioid cancer arises when its components (EP300/CREBBP, CTCFL, SMARCE1) are constitutively disrupted, removing the same brake on proliferative and hormone-responsive genes.
reasoning: The module is nameable from the factors alone (CBP/p300 coactivation, PRC2 recruitment via JARID2, BAF remodeling via SMARCE1, insulator reprogramming via CTCFL) and each disease independently has retrieved evidence placing components in it — but no source states a COVID-19/endometrioid-cancer connection directly, and the endometrioid evidence rests on a single case report plus ovarian-cancer papers of uncertain histology, while the JARID2-COVID link is a computational miRNA prediction. Concordance for the carrying factors sits at 22-24 of 48 comparisons, a real majority but not near-total.
support: PMID 25675181 — Rubinstein-Taybi (EP300/CREBBP) patient with synchronous endometrioid adenocarcinoma; PMID 33398248 — SARS-CoV-2 predicted miRNAs targeting JARID2 within NF-κB/JAK-STAT/TGFB signaling; PMID 31516605 — CTCFL upregulated in high-grade epithelial ovarian carcinoma; PMID 31406110 — CTCFL (BORIS) controls the androgen receptor regulatory network in ovarian cancer; PMID 31292201 — BORIS expression in ovarian cancer precursor cells alters the CTCF cistrome and enhances invasion.
how_to_falsify: Treat SARS-CoV-2-infected airway epithelial cells/PBMCs and endometrioid cancer cell lines in parallel with a p300/CBP HAT inhibitor (e.g., A-485); if the shared module is real, inhibition should blunt NF-κB/IRF-driven cytokine transcription in the infection model and independently suppress proliferation or restore differentiation markers in the cancer model. A complementary test is ChIP-seq/ATAC-seq for EP300 and JARID2 co-occupancy at shared candidate loci (e.g., IL6, CXCL8) in infected epithelium versus endometrioid tumor tissue — the account predicts overlapping regulated loci; finding none would undercut it.
caveats: Tissue pairing (blood vs. uterine endometrium) is broad, and the 48 patient-group comparisons come from only 4 independent cohort pairs, so apparent replication is inflated relative to true independent evidence. Endometrioid-specific literature is thin throughout — it leans on one case report and on ovarian-cancer papers that may not specify endometrioid histology, as the record itself notes. POU3F1, despite the highest concordance (28/48), has no Open Targets or literature support in either disease and does not mechanistically fit this chromatin module, so it is excluded from carrying_factors rather than forced in; LMX1B, MXD1, NR2C2, NFIL3, ZNF148 and HOPX are concordant but do not cohere with the acetylation/remodeling story either. BRCA1 was removed as tissue-generic, which is why a DNA-damage-repair framing (which EP300/CREBBP could otherwise suggest) is not used here.
